sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Orient the players without dumping lore. Keep proper nouns gated for the played briefing.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Contract = overview. The Job = played briefing. Entering Sablewood = threshold transition.
The package's true name stays out of player-facing Prologue text.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: All right, we are moving from Session Zero into the fiction. Here is what your characters know before the first conversation: you have a courier contract, the pay is good, the package is sealed, and the route runs through a huge old forest to a small village. You do not need to know the names yet. If you want details, ask the contact once the scene starts.
